0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, on a three-game losing streak), with the Nets sitting 13th in the East and the Pelicans 11th in the West. Egor Demin is out for the Nets with a leg bruise, and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. For New Orleans, Trendon Watford is out with an ankle injury, Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee tendinitis game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 116-113 Nets loss in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
